name: @estebanforge/pi-unblock
description: Event-driven unblock gate: when the session's tool failures stack into a loop, consults a cross-family reviewer through a one-shot headless run and injects the guidance as a visible notice. Also guards publish boundaries (git push / gh pr create) behind a confirm-and-consult step. No model-facing tool: the trigger is deterministic, so the session cannot talk itself out of it.
